description: The L1 band from a driving receiver following a five-second trajectory plan between two points, starting and ending at rest: GPS L1 C/A and L1C, Galileo E1 and BDS B1C at 1575.42 MHz with BDS B1I at 1561.098 MHz in one 20 MHz IQ4 stream centred between them.
name: l1_band_gps_galileo_bds
